Great, I see $1280 from @michael_sibling in the Venmo record, tagged for 3125 Woodland Ave. The payment landed at 3:41 PM yesterday, so we're set on your portion.
Awesome. Let me know if the landlord, Mrs. Patel, needs a screenshot or the transaction ID.
Thanks, Michael! If Mrs. Patel (patel.rentals@gmail.com) asks, I'll send her the transaction ID 67B9TR42. Usually she checks the account by noon on the 3rd, so it's good to have it ready.
Understood. If she follows up, just CC my number, 415-233-4112, on any email chain.
